description:
Clicking a cluster box in the web UI graph view selects the cluster's layout node id as if it were an issue id, so the issue detail panel requests a nonexistent issue and the server logs an error for every request.

## Background

The cluster-aware layout creates visual group nodes whose ids take the form `cluster-<uuid>` (`web/src/components/Graph/GraphView.tsx:221`). The graph's node click handler forwards every clicked node's id to `onNodeClick` without distinguishing issue nodes from cluster nodes (`web/src/components/Graph/GraphView.tsx:974-980`), and the application stores that id as the selected issue (`web/src/App.tsx:233`). The detail panel then fetches `/api/issues/cluster-<uuid>`, which fails, and `crates/server/src/routes.rs:101` logs `Failed to get issue cluster-...: Issue not found` at error level.

An adopter's server log showed this error repeated about once per second for as long as the panel stayed open, which buries real server errors.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Clicking a cluster node never changes the selected issue.
- [hard] REQ-02: Clicking an issue node still selects that issue.
- [hard] REQ-03: A regression test fails if a cluster node click reaches issue selection.

## Notes

Whether a cluster click should instead toggle expansion is a separate design choice and out of scope.
title: Clicking a graph cluster box selects its layout id as an issue
